_why: THE CONTROL OF THE EXPERIMENT. U4 compares quadrants by running the same anchored item
in each; 'the same' is the only control the comparison has, so it is a committed
artifact with a content digest rather than a prompt somebody retypes per run.
WHY THIS TASK. It has to be (a) small enough that a local model on the little-coder
runner can plausibly finish it, or the local quadrants measure the task's size rather
than the runner; (b) discriminating - the accent-folding and separator-collapsing cases
are where a weaker model's naive regex actually fails, so the acceptance rate carries
information instead of being 2/2 everywhere; (c) checkable with the standard library
alone, because a quadrant that fails on a missing package has told you nothing about
the quadrant; and (d) portable, because the same item must run in a worktree of THIS
repository (target self) and in a scratch clone (target project) unchanged.
WHY THE TASK TEXT IS A FIELD AND NOT A README IN files/. Whatever is planted is
writable by the runner. The instructions have to come from outside the workspace or a
runner can rewrite its own brief - which, unlike editing the tests, would not even
leave a trace in the acceptance results.
task: The directory `quadrant-item/` in this workspace contains two files: `slugify.py`, which holds a stub `slugify(text)` that raises NotImplementedError, and `test_slugify.py`, which specifies exactly what `slugify` must do. Implement `slugify(text)` in `quadrant-item/slugify.py` so that every test in `quadrant-item/test_slugify.py` passes. Use only the Python standard library. Do NOT modify `quadrant-item/test_slugify.py`. Do NOT create or modify any file other than `quadrant-item/slugify.py`. When the implementation is complete, stop.

fixture_solution._why: used ONLY by the self-test fixture runner, which is why it lives outside files/ and outside the item digest: it is not part of what a real runner is given.
